coverage_gaps: This supplemental batch provides eight candidate PNGs and no independent reference PNGs. Visual judgments use the explicit scope, handoff, prototype text, and case identity metadata; no other images were loaded.

The batch covers only Scribe landscape resume, reversed tap result, seek baseline/preview/release, center/side boundary results, and contents last page. It does not establish a complete round or clean-round result.

The final contents page has only two records. It supports the two-column final-page layout and content-height behavior, but does not independently show the full three-row contents capacity or stability across every folio transition.

Static captures show final visible states rather than event timing, the actual 30/40/30 hit boundaries, reversal routing, menu-open input suppression, or the absence of an invisible footer-cycle hit zone.
limitations: Each of the eight original candidate PNGs was directly opened with view_image. Current SHA256 values were obtained with Get-FileHash and matched both expected_png_sha256 and case evidence_hashes.screenshot.sha256.

All eight case sidecars identify round 1, run a1baf3fe3dc2, binary 94d7f3bbcab475ad8833a2f3c486138f7b49bead231851c2d8eab2f0c3d2ac51, and source aef9db4e111165016a10a2a95e111f3155860b8510c7f6207ec9c79fbec5082c. The text sources used were docs/review/phase3-reference-scope.json, docs/DESIGN_HANDOFF.md, and the exported HANDOFF.md, prototype/sc-reader.dc.html, and prototype/spec-interaction.dc.html. The closed-reader artwork-only scope override takes precedence over obsolete ribbon/footer behavior.
